title: tc-integration-grid
description: A wall of integration logos around your product mark.

logos.description: Up to 22 logos, filled row by row around the centre tile – defaults to a set of well-known tools

columns.description: Tiles in the middle row – 9 by default; the rows above and below get two fewer. Use 7 or 5 for a tighter grid

label.description: Accessible description of the scene – defaults to "Integrates with …" and the logos' names

path.description: A single SVG path on a 24 × 24 viewBox (e.g. from simple-icons)

color.description: Fill color – leave it out for black marks that should follow the ink color (and turn light in dark mode)

darkColor.description: Optional fill color in dark mode, for brand colors that are too dark on a dark tile
